title: Head - Planning
description:
**Location:** 
 Sri City, Andhra Pradesh, India, 517 646
   

  

**Company:** 
 Chart Industries
   

  

***Ensuring Chart’s Success…***
**VRV Asia Pacific Pvt. Ltd!!!A CHART Industries Company.**
 We are a US Multi\-National Company, wedesignand fabricate state\-of\-the\-art vacuum insulated cryogenic storage tanks for the distribution \& storage of liquefied gases such as nitrogen, oxygen, argon, LNG (natural gas), hydrogen and other hydrocarbons for use in industrial, healthcare, electronics, food \& energy.
   

  

**Our vision** 
 ,
 **"Providing engineered solutions to enable a better tomorrow”** 
 , embodies our commitment to innovation and sustainability. Every decision we make contributes to a safer, stronger, and more resilient future for our customers, our communities, and each of us.
   

  

**Our mission** 
 ,
 **"We connect our people, leading technologies, and global expertise to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers and the world around us"** 
 , focuses on using our strengths to achieve success. We bring together world\-class talent, leading technologies, and unmatched global expertise to deliver innovative and sustainable solutions. The strength of our people, our partnerships, and our pursuit of excellence drives us forward.
   

  

**Our Values – The Foundation Of Our Success**
 Our five values define how we work, how we collaborate, and how we grow:
   

  

* Safety Above All
* Here for Our Customers
* People Make the Difference
* Pursue Excellence
* Passion for Results


***Job Profile***
**Position: Head – Planning**
 Reporting to : Site Leader
   

  

 Location : Sri City, Tada, Andhra Pradesh (Near Chennai)
   

  

**Your Experience Should Be...**
 BE / B. Tech (Mech.) with 20\+ years of experience in Cryogenic / Pressure Vessels / Oil \& Gas / Boilers industry or any capital goods manufacturing industry.
   

  

 Good computer skills with MSProject/ Primavera
   

  

 Good knowledge in SAP is must.
   

  

 Should have good knowledge in Production Planning, Scheduling, Forecasting, Estimation \& Budgeting
   

  

***What Will You Do?***
* Sale order review, budgeting,planning, \& scheduling ofjobordersin SAP.
* Organize regularkick off /Interface meetingswith internal stake holdersand escalate theprojectissues / concerns for timely resolution by internalprojectteams.
* Co\-ordination with client for the approval of technical documents like QAP, process sheet, Drawings etc and ensuring timely receipt of approved documents.
* Monitor, control and direct all aspects of activities for the execution of nominatedprojectscope to achieve completion within defined budgetary and time delivery targets.
* Handing over formalities with customer andProjectclosure.
* Co\-ordination with client / customers regardingprojectprogress,projectplanning / scheduling, resolution or areas of concerns and technical issues.
* Ensure that specificprojectrequirements and procedures are communicated to all parties, team members, sub\-contractors, etc., and that all activities are coordinated to ensure meeting the commonprojectobjectives.
* Analyze delays in Procurement of Critical and Long Lead items.
* Maintain Checklist for Readiness of variousProjectActivities.
* Advise to the management on any deviations from authorizedprojectschedule in a manner as to best effect recovery to original plan.
* Monitor and expedite logistics supports for on time delivery ofprojectmaterials
* Planning for billing and dispatch of products with suitable documents.
* Final technical and commercial documents submission and payment follow\-up
